p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-openclawlearner-1792497764/attempts/ff04010ea19b4e2796afd219b7bae1c0/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ae215a27.py'
text='''def transform(grid):
    # The colored connected template is stamped at every matching zero-only
    # placement; background and all non-template cells remain unchanged.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    color = next(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                 if grid[r][c] not in (0, 6, 9))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = {(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells}
    sh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    sw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = color
    return out
'''
